evals.name: drifted-namespaces
evals.prompt: Which components use a different namespace name in some environments than others?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage preflight` then `cub manage namespace consistency --issues-only` and reports the components whose namespace name differs across variant Spaces (NamespaceConsistent false). Read-only.

evals.name: one-component
evals.prompt: Is the apptique namespace consistent across all its environments?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage namespace consistency --component apptique` and reports whether apptique's namespace name and pod-security level are identical across its variant Spaces, listing the variants.

evals.name: routes-completeness-elsewhere
evals.prompt: Does the payments namespace have a default-deny?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that NetworkPolicy coverage is not this tool's subject at all: cub manage namespace no longer reports default-deny, so it routes to netpol-audit / the cub manage netpol tool rather than running a cub manage namespace command.
